[Thinking]
**Designing API endpoints**

I need to respond in Italian for the user's request to "Scrivi endpoints per un business car-rental." This suggests they're looking for a design of API endpoints. It's essential to provide concise REST endpoints and include relevant resources. I’ll want to focus on the key functionality needed for a car rental business, such as booking, vehicle availability, and customer management. Let’s ensure clarity and completeness in the endpoints I outline!
[/Thinking]

Ecco una possibile lista di **REST API endpoints** per un business di **car rental / noleggio auto**.

## Autenticazione

```http
POST /api/auth/register
POST /api/auth/login
POST /api/auth/logout
POST /api/auth/refresh-token
POST /api/auth/forgot-password
POST /api/auth/reset-password
```

---

## Utenti / Clienti

```http
GET    /api/users
GET    /api/users/{userId}
POST   /api/users
PUT    /api/users/{userId}
PATCH  /api/users/{userId}
DELETE /api/users/{userId}
```

### Profilo cliente

```http
GET   /api/me
PUT   /api/me
PATCH /api/me
```

---

## Documenti cliente

Per patente, carta d’identità, passaporto, ecc.

```http
GET    /api/users/{userId}/documents
POST   /api/users/{userId}/documents
GET    /api/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}
PUT    /api/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}
DELETE /api/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}
```

---

## Auto / Veicoli

```http
GET    /api/cars
GET    /api/cars/{carId}
POST   /api/cars
PUT    /api/cars/{carId}
PATCH  /api/cars/{carId}
DELETE /api/cars/{carId}
```

### Ricerca auto disponibili

```http
GET /api/cars/available
```

Esempio query:

```http
GET /api/cars/available?pickupLocationId=1&dropoffLocationId=2&startDate=2026-06-01&endDate=2026-06-07&category=suv
```

---

## Categorie auto

Esempi: economy, compact, sedan, SUV, luxury, van.

```http
GET    /api/car-categories
GET    /api/car-categories/{categoryId}
POST   /api/car-categories
PUT    /api/car-categories/{categoryId}
DELETE /api/car-categories/{categoryId}
```

---

## Brand e modelli

```http
GET    /api/car-brands
POST   /api/car-brands
GET    /api/car-brands/{brandId}
PUT    /api/car-brands/{brandId}
DELETE /api/car-brands/{brandId}
```

```http
GET    /api/car-models
POST   /api/car-models
GET    /api/car-models/{modelId}
PUT    /api/car-models/{modelId}
DELETE /api/car-models/{modelId}
```

---

## Sedi / Filiali

```http
GET    /api/locations
GET    /api/locations/{locationId}
POST   /api/locations
PUT    /api/locations/{locationId}
DELETE /api/locations/{locationId}
```

### Auto disponibili in una sede

```http
GET /api/locations/{locationId}/cars
GET /api/locations/{locationId}/available-cars
```

---

## Prenotazioni

```http
GET    /api/bookings
GET    /api/bookings/{bookingId}
POST   /api/bookings
PUT    /api/bookings/{bookingId}
PATCH  /api/bookings/{bookingId}
DELETE /api/bookings/{bookingId}
```

### Prenotazioni utente

```http
GET /api/users/{userId}/bookings
GET /api/me/bookings
```

### Cambiare stato prenotazione

```http
PATCH /api/bookings/{bookingId}/status
```

Possibili stati:

```txt
pending
confirmed
cancelled
completed
no_show
```

### Cancellare prenotazione

```http
POST /api/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel
```

---

## Preventivi / Quotazioni prezzo

```http
POST /api/quotes
```

Esempio body:

```json
{
  "carId": "123",
  "pickupLocationId": "1",
  "dropoffLocationId": "2",
  "startDate": "2026-06-01T10:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-06-07T10:00:00Z",
  "extras": ["gps", "child_seat"],
  "insurancePackageId": "premium"
}
```

Risposta esempio:

```json
{
  "dailyRate": 45,
  "days": 6,
  "extrasTotal": 40,
  "insuranceTotal": 90,
  "taxes": 38,
  "total": 438,
  "currency": "EUR"
}
```

---

## Pagamenti

```http
GET    /api/payments
GET    /api/payments/{paymentId}
POST   /api/payments
POST   /api/payments/{paymentId}/refund
GET    /api/bookings/{bookingId}/payments
```

### Payment intent

Utile per Stripe, PayPal, Nexi, ecc.

```http
POST /api/payments/create-intent
```

---

## Fatture

```http
GET  /api/invoices
GET  /api/invoices/{invoiceId}
POST /api/invoices
GET  /api/bookings/{bookingId}/invoice
```

### Download fattura PDF

```http
GET /api/invoices/{invoiceId}/download
```

---

## Assicurazioni

```http
GET    /api/insurance-packages
GET    /api/insurance-packages/{insuranceId}
POST   /api/insurance-packages
PUT    /api/insurance-packages/{insuranceId}
DELETE /api/insurance-packages/{insuranceId}
```

---

## Extra noleggio

Esempi: GPS, seggiolino, catene da neve, conducente aggiuntivo.

```http
GET    /api/extras
GET    /api/extras/{extraId}
POST   /api/extras
PUT    /api/extras/{extraId}
DELETE /api/extras/{extraId}
```

---

## Contratti di noleggio

```http
GET    /api/rental-agreements
GET    /api/rental-agreements/{agreementId}
POST   /api/rental-agreements
PUT    /api/rental-agreements/{agreementId}
DELETE /api/rental-agreements/{agreementId}
```

### Contratto associato a prenotazione

```http
GET /api/bookings/{bookingId}/rental-agreement
POST /api/bookings/{bookingId}/rental-agreement
```

### Firma contratto

```http
POST /api/rental-agreements/{agreementId}/sign
```

---

## Check-in e ritiro auto

```http
POST /api/bookings/{bookingId}/check-in
POST /api/bookings/{bookingId}/pickup
```

Esempio body per pickup:

```json
{
  "mileage": 24500,
  "fuelLevel": "full",
  "damageNotes": "Piccolo graffio sul paraurti posteriore",
  "photos": ["photo1.jpg", "photo2.jpg"]
}
```

---

## Check-out e riconsegna auto

```http
POST /api/bookings/{bookingId}/return
POST /api/bookings/{bookingId}/check-out
```

Esempio body:

```json
{
  "mileage": 25120,
  "fuelLevel": "half",
  "damageNotes": "Nessun nuovo danno",
  "photos": ["return1.jpg", "return2.jpg"]
}
```

---

## Danni veicolo

```http
GET    /api/damages
GET    /api/damages/{damageId}
POST   /api/damages
PUT    /api/damages/{damageId}
DELETE /api/damages/{damageId}
```

### Danni per veicolo

```http
GET  /api/cars/{carId}/damages
POST /api/cars/{carId}/damages
```

### Danni per prenotazione

```http
GET  /api/bookings/{bookingId}/damages
POST /api/bookings/{bookingId}/damages
```

---

## Manutenzione veicoli

```http
GET    /api/maintenance
GET    /api/maintenance/{maintenanceId}
POST   /api/maintenance
PUT    /api/maintenance/{maintenanceId}
DELETE /api/maintenance/{maintenanceId}
```

### Manutenzione per auto

```http
GET  /api/cars/{carId}/maintenance
POST /api/cars/{carId}/maintenance
```

---

## Disponibilità auto

```http
GET  /api/availability
POST /api/availability/check
```

Esempio:

```http
POST /api/availability/check
```

```json
{
  "carId": "123",
  "startDate": "2026-06-01T10:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-06-07T10:00:00Z"
}
```

---

## Tariffe e prezzi

```http
GET    /api/pricing-rules
GET    /api/pricing-rules/{ruleId}
POST   /api/pricing-rules
PUT    /api/pricing-rules/{ruleId}
DELETE /api/pricing-rules/{ruleId}
```

Esempi di regole:

```txt
prezzo giornaliero
prezzo weekend
alta stagione
sconto settimanale
chilometraggio extra
costo riconsegna in sede diversa
```

---

## Coupon e sconti

```http
GET    /api/coupons
GET    /api/coupons/{couponId}
POST   /api/coupons
PUT    /api/coupons/{couponId}
DELETE /api/coupons/{couponId}
POST   /api/coupons/validate
```

---

## Recensioni

```http
GET    /api/reviews
GET    /api/reviews/{reviewId}
POST   /api/reviews
PUT    /api/reviews/{reviewId}
DELETE /api/reviews/{reviewId}
```

### Recensioni auto

```http
GET /api/cars/{carId}/reviews
```

### Recensioni utente

```http
GET /api/users/{userId}/reviews
```

---

## Notifiche

```http
GET    /api/notifications
GET    /api/notifications/{notificationId}
POST   /api/notifications
PATCH  /api/notifications/{notificationId}/read
DELETE /api/notifications/{notificationId}
```

---

## Admin dashboard

```http
GET /api/admin/dashboard
GET /api/admin/stats/bookings
GET /api/admin/stats/revenue
GET /api/admin/stats/cars
GET /api/admin/stats/customers
```

---

## Esempio endpoint principale per creare una prenotazione

```http
POST /api/bookings
```

Body:

```json
{
  "userId": "789",
  "carId": "123",
  "pickupLocationId": "1",
  "dropoffLocationId": "2",
  "startDate": "2026-06-01T10:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-06-07T10:00:00Z",
  "extras": ["gps", "child_seat"],
  "insurancePackageId": "premium",
  "couponCode": "SUMMER20"
}
```

Risposta:

```json
{
  "id": "booking_456",
  "status": "pending",
  "userId": "789",
  "carId": "123",
  "totalPrice": 438,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "paymentStatus": "unpaid",
  "createdAt": "2026-05-22T12:00:00Z"
}
```

---

## Stati principali

### Stato auto

```txt
available
rented
maintenance
inactive
reserved
```

### Stato prenotazione

```txt
pending
confirmed
cancelled
completed
no_show
```

### Stato pagamento

```txt
pending
paid
failed
refunded
partially_refunded
```

### Stato contratto

```txt
draft
signed
cancelled
completed
```
